mapper.select: SELECT FRIDGE_ID, USER_ID, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, EXPIRE_DATE, REGISTERED_AT FROM FRIDGE_INGREDIENTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY EXPIRE_DATE ASC NULLS LAST, REGISTERED_AT DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FRIDGE_INGREDIENTS WHERE FRIDGE_ID = #{fridgeId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
